information: ## Have no fear! Duper Super Davis Spring is here! ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTcyOTI4LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--dbf468624421ce2bc7ac4e013a5ecaa88d60d365/dsdscubecow%20(2).png) - All attendees under the age of 18 are required to be accompanied by a parent or guardian. - Competition attendees may **appear on livestream and media**. - If we run ahead of schedule, we will start first round events no earlier than 20 minutes. - Competitors may not compete in an event if they miss last call for that event. In general, last call is a few minutes after the last group is called. **This competition is organized in partnership with [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/) and [Speedcubeshop](https://speedcubeshop.com/).** ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ0dKIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--60fae70c3e469b91d58257f4370c58af47b487da/scswcc5.png) ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTMxNjA2LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--6abcc9425f1e30a6e5cb6293124d0575e8c449f8/image.png) ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6Njg3OTAsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--f0643a286a955df61f35887df56b46d88342d211/image.png) This competition will be streamed live on the [West Coast Cubing](https://www.youtube.com/@WestCoastCubing), [CubersLive](https://www.youtube.com/@Cubers-Live), and [SpeedCubeShop](https://www.youtube.com/@SpeedCubeShopOfficial) YouTube channels.
